title: Login allows access to the dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with valid credentials and reaches the authenticated dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Bootstrap first-run setup creates super admin and lands on dashboard
description: Verifies a first-run user can complete setup to create the initial super_admin and is automatically logged in to the dashboard with a workspace visible in the sidebar.

steps.description: Navigate to /setup
Fill a new unique email into the email field
Fill a valid password (at least 8 characters) into the password field
Fill a display name into the display name field
Submit the setup form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify at least one workspace is visible in the sidebar

title: Real-time note edits sync across two sessions
description: Verifies that when a user edits a note in one browser session and it auto-saves, another session viewing the same note receives the update without refresh.

steps.description: In Browser A, navigate to /login
In Browser A, fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
In Browser A, fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
In Browser A, submit the login form
In Browser B, navigate to /login
In Browser B, fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
In Browser B, fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
In Browser B, submit the login form
In Browser A, open an existing note from the current workspace note list
In Browser B, open the same note from the current workspace note list
In Browser A, edit the note content by adding a unique line of text like "RealtimeSyncLine-1"
In Browser A, wait for 3 seconds to allow auto-save to complete
Verify Browser B shows the updated note content including the unique line without a manual refresh

title: Create note in a workspace and autosave after idle
description: Verifies a user can open a workspace, create a new note, and see it saved and listed after being idle for 2 seconds.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open a workspace from the sidebar
Create a new note
Fill a unique title into the note title field
Fill Markdown content into the note editor
Wait for 2 seconds
Verify the new note is listed in the workspace note list

title: Edit existing note and autosave persists after reopening
description: Verifies a user can edit an existing note, wait for autosave, reopen it, and see the updated content persisted.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open a workspace from the sidebar
Create a new note
Fill a unique title into the note title field
Fill initial content into the note editor
Wait for 2 seconds
Open the created note from the note list
Edit the note content by appending a new line of text
Wait for 2 seconds
Open a different note or return to the note list view
Reopen the edited note from the note list
Verify the edited content is displayed in the note editor

title: Global search filters notes by title in real time
description: Verifies typing in global search filters the visible note list by title as the user types.

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}

Fill a different unique title into the note title field
Fill content into the note editor
Wait for 2 seconds

Verify the note list shows only notes whose titles match the query
